prompt: Hokusai, an elderly bald painter in a green robe, sits on plain cream paper with a calm, focused expression. His gaze sharpens and he raises his hand as if holding a brush. A single bold stroke of Prussian blue ink sweeps across the paper behind him, swelling and curling into a giant wave with claw-like white foam. The camera dollies forward as the ink wave rushes past in layered parallax and fills the whole screen, revealing the woodblock print 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' with three boats and a small Mount Fuji in the distance. Motion design for a large digital signage screen in a modern train station concourse: dynamic cinematic camera moves, layered parallax depth, crisp confident timing, and a refined, elegant Japanese atmosphere. Everything moves as if truly alive. Keep the flat ukiyo-e look: crisp ink outlines, flat colors, washi paper texture, no realistic shading.
